image_description: A medium shot of a three-person band performing on an elevated stage. From left to right: a guitarist with long hair playing a light-colored electric guitar, a bassist in the center playing a dark bass guitar, and a lead singer on the right holding a microphone. The background features a large banner with partial text and graphics. Stage equipment, including monitors and stands, is visible at their feet.

The connection between the neck and the body of the bass guitar is slightly ambiguous, with the tuning pegs appearing somewhat soft and indistinct.
